source: iq9a-dev post-remediation run (post7) and its canonical traces
additional_finding: device clarification continuation inherits the PENDING workflow direction (on) when the new message states "off" without a verb (wrong-direction proposal).

items.why: mixed turn: the hazard precaution is given but the question "has anyone been told" is not answered
unverified assurance refused correctly; the answer omits what is recorded
compound: log it + tell me it is confirmed; both parts mishandled
mixed turn: hazard handler answers and drops the camera question
assurance refusal correct; omits the recorded burst-pipe context
Office reassurance request reaches the maintenance out-of-scope fallback before the refusal
public safety rumour about Ochiga estates: no incident source; assessment template claims the opportunity "could not be read"
camera question after a report answered by the generic assessment template; residents have no camera access
hazard + action: "AC is sparking, switch it off now" becomes an ordinary device proposal with no hazard acknowledgement; stale-workflow state handling also unsafe
urgent-attention question answered by the menu-fallback listing without urgency framing
cancellation is right; the answer omits that the device state is unknown from stale readings
compound: withdraw the AC request and do the kitchen one; the proposal also took the stale workflow direction (on) instead of the stated "off"; the turn then falls to a read
"hold on, don't send it" is a hold/withdrawal of a request that never executed, not handled; falls to a read
compound: withdrawal plus a status question; only the question is answered
"never mind the generators, switch them back on again later" is read as a standing constraint; a withdrawal plus a future request
"scrap the email" is not a recognised withdrawal verb
compound: withdrawal plus a field question; routed to the assessment template
follow-up "current balance" after a figures constraint loses the financial-summary context and hits the Office out-of-scope wallet fallback
compound: withdrawal of a callback plus "keep what I told you"; only the recall is answered
a stored contact constraint (never by phone) is not available to the later call request, and "arrange a call" reaches the menu fallback
ordinal resolved to the right record, but the follow-up question (how urgent) is not a supported field, so only the status is returned
"theirs" (pronoun for another party) is not read as another-person scope, so the refused scope request is not carried to the follow-up; falls to the unsupported fallback instead of the scope refusal
ordinal resolved correctly but the answer uses the internal reference label (W11-TOPUP) and omits money direction; the field "in or out" is not supported
elliptical "same for X place" has no domain; neighbour scope is known but the unsupported fallback answers instead of the scope refusal
"the other one" is not a supported follow-up reference
"which is the active one" is not a supported follow-up attribute
ordinal follow-up about a derived assessment list is answered by the generic assessment template instead of the referent record's own recorded age
units-sold has no source; the follow-up should state the limitation for the already-resolved project, the answer re-lists the project
the communication handler resolves "the first one" against the staff directory instead of the preceding result set
"what do you have on that one so far" is not read as held-fact recall, so the acknowledgement template wins
a refusal-worthy request without the words "your/internal" (list the weights) reaches the menu fallback; the earlier refusal context is not used
"has all that been passed to your team" is not recognised as a handoff-state question (passive "passed", subject "all that")
"what about the other one" is not a supported follow-up reference
a question about the handoff capability itself reaches the menu fallback
open-items question answered by the assessment template
"they've been told right? how long til they call" exceeds the outcome-question length bound
record exists; the answer does not say whether anyone is working on it
compound conversation: new information then a handoff-state question; second part correct, composition incomplete
owner field is recorded for the stale opportunities but the assessment template answers
the Osa module uses its own narrow callback regex ("call me back" not matched) instead of the shared target callback; the request is acknowledged as a fact update
